assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a transparent PNG technical sprite sheet matching the attached Mage reference. Canvas 2048 pixels wide, 1024 pixels high, 2:1 landscape. No background, scenery, drawn grids, numbers, letters, text, drop shadows, border or checkerboard. The sprites MUST be small inside generously padded square cells; do not crop or overlap.
